text: add_cpr_info() appends selected information preserving original CPR column. Dashes, spaces, lost leading zeroes handled internally. Use clean_cpr() explicitly also want standardise source column. functions share native cleaning rules. add_cpr_info() parses CPR requested outputs, including multiple age calculations. need separate cleaning step just calculate CPR information. Use explicit cleaning step identifier also used joins export: clean_cpr() idempotent: cleaning gives values. Already standardised character vectors returned without replacement vector. Without selections, function adds bday, age, sex, mod11, valid. Bare age age() use today’s date; explicit references make analysis reproducible. Write output_name = calculation rename result. age calculation reference, several ages can added one call: age(year) defaults "primo" primo = "previous_ultimo" (31 December previous year); "medio" means 1 July "ultimo" means 31 December. year can scalar, column, expression evaluated original input data. default makes opening ages equal previous year’s closing ages. can also written explicitly: Someone born 1 January 2000 0 counting year 2001; age(year, primo = "jan1") instead includes day’s birthday gives 1. specific date, use age(date = ...) Date ISO date string. Supply one reference rows one per row. Missing references give missing ages. Use .env$name explicitly access caller variable column name. Existing output names cause error guidance rename selection use overwrite = TRUE. Duplicate output names always error, source CPR column overwritten. valid means ten digits encoding real calendar date, confirmation CPR number assigned. Missing invalid CPR values give valid = FALSE. mod11 independent checksum part valid. Choose mod11 explicitly selecting outputs need . former add, ref_date, year, arguments replaced selections age(). example, add = c(alder = "age"), year = year becomes alder = age(year). source CPR column now preserved. Age counts completed calendar years, elapsed days divided 365.25. person born 29 February, age increases 29 February leap years 1 March non-leap years. birth date 29 February 2000: age(2024) means age 31 December 2023. default, giving age 23 example.
